description: This file is a database migration script using Alembic for setting up and maintaining the 'users' table with associated constraints, enums, and indexes. It ensures idempotency and handles both online and offline migration scenarios.

methods.name: None _log(msg: str)
methods.description: Logs diagnostic messages for the migration process.

methods.name: str _current_schema(bind)
methods.description: Retrieves the current schema name in the database session.

methods.name: bool _table_exists(bind, schema: str, table: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists within the schema.

methods.name: bool _column_exists(bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: bool _index_exists(bind, schema: str, index_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific index exists by name within the schema.

methods.name: bool _has_primary_key(bind, schema: str, table: str)
methods.description: Checks if a table has a primary key constraint.

methods.name: str _qualified_name(schema: str, table: str)
methods.description: Constructs properly quoted qualified table name.

methods.name: None _create_enum_if_missing(enum_name: str, values: list[str])
methods.description: Creates a PostgreSQL ENUM type if it does not already exist.

methods.name: None _safe_add_column(bind, schema: str, table: str, column_sql: str)
methods.description: Adds a column to a table if it does not already exist.

methods.name: None _ensure_unique_index(bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str, index_name: str)
methods.description: Ensures a unique index exists on a table column, skipping if duplicates are detected.

methods.name: None _ensure_pk_on(bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str)
methods.description: Ensures that a primary key exists on a specific column, attempting to add it if missing.

methods.name: None _ensure_users_table_and_columns(bind)
methods.description: Creates the 'users' table and ensures all required columns, enum types, constraints, and indexes are present.

methods.name: upgrade()
methods.description: Performs the migration to ensure the 'users' table and related constraints are correctly set up, handling both offline and online modes.

methods.name: downgrade()
methods.description: Removes the indexes created by this migration without dropping the 'users' table or enum types.

search-terms: migration with online and offline modes

ctags.name: _column_exists
ctags.pattern: /^def _column_exists(bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str)

ctags.name: _ensure_pk_on
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure_pk_on(bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str)

ctags.name: _ensure_unique_index
ctags.pattern: /^def _ensure_unique_index(bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str, index_name: str) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (bind, schema: str, table: str, column: str, index_name: str)

ctags.name: _safe_add_column
ctags.pattern: /^def _safe_add_column(bind, schema: str, table: str, column_sql: str) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (bind, schema: str, table: str, column_sql: str)
